q: How many men did Moses send to spy out Canaan, one from each tribe?
quote: From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.

q: What did the twelve spies carry on a pole between two men?
quote: they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men.

q: How many days did the twelve spies explore Canaan?
quote: After forty days the men returned from spying out the land

q: The twelve spies said Canaan was flowing with what?
quote: and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey.

q: Which spy said, “We can certainly conquer it!”?
quote: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said, “We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!”

q: Beside Canaan's giants, the fearful spies said they seemed like what?
quote: We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight

q: Which two spies tore their clothes and urged Israel to trust God?
why: They said the land was very good.
quote: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes

q: After the spies' bad report, who alone of that generation would enter Canaan?
quote: except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

q: What animal did Balaam ride when going with the princes of Moab?
why: God had a lesson for him.
quote: So in the morning Balaam got up, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

q: What did Balaam's donkey see standing in the road?
quote: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand

q: What amazing thing did the LORD let Balaam's donkey do?
why: She asked why he beat her.
quote: Then the LORD opened the donkey’s mouth, and she said to Balaam

q: How many times had Balaam beaten his donkey when she spoke?
why: She had turned from the angel.
quote: What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times?

q: When Balaam's donkey saw the angel in a narrow place, what did she do?
why: There was no room to turn.
quote: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam

q: When the LORD opened Balaam's eyes, what did Balaam do?
why: He saw the angel with a sword.
quote: And Balaam bowed low and fell facedown.

q: After meeting the angel, what was Balaam allowed to speak?
quote: but you are to speak only what I tell you.

q: How does the priestly blessing in Numbers begin?
quote: May the LORD bless you and keep you

q: In Numbers, how is Moses described, more than any man on earth?
quote: Now Moses was a very humble man, more so than any man on the face of the earth.

q: In Numbers, what did Moses put on a pole to heal bitten Israelites?
quote: So Moses made a bronze snake and mounted it on a pole.

q: The priestly blessing in Numbers ends asking the LORD to give you what?
why: May He lift His face toward you.
quote: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.

q: In Numbers, how did the cloud over the tabernacle look at night?
quote: the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.

q: In Numbers, what food did complaining Israelites say they were tired of?
quote: there is nothing to see but this manna!

q: In Numbers, how many years did Israel wander, a year for each spying day?
quote: In keeping with the forty days you spied out the land, you shall bear your guilt forty years—a year for each day

q: In Numbers, whose staff sprouted, blossomed, and produced almonds?
quote: and saw that Aaron’s staff, representing the house of Levi, had sprouted, put forth buds, blossomed, and produced almonds.

q: In Numbers, what did Moses do to the rock instead of speaking to it?
quote: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff

q: In Numbers, why could Moses and Aaron not lead Israel into the land?
quote: Because you did not trust Me to show My holiness in the sight of the Israelites

q: In Numbers, Balaam says God is not a man, that He should do what?
quote: God is not a man, that He should lie

q: In Numbers, whom did God tell Moses to lay hands on as the next leader?
why: He had the Spirit in him.
quote: Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.

q: In Numbers, which giant people did the spies see in Canaan?
quote: We even saw the descendants of Anak there.

q: In which valley did the spies cut the great cluster of grapes?
quote: When they came to the Valley of Eshcol

q: Where was Israel camped when the twelve spies returned?
quote: in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh.

q: In Numbers, which vegetables did Israel miss from Egypt?
why: They also missed fish and melons.
quote: along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.

q: In Numbers, in which wilderness did the LORD speak to Moses at the start of the book?
why: It was the second year after Egypt.
quote: the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai.

q: Which king's princes did Balaam travel with?
quote: So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

q: What did Balaam's donkey crush against a vineyard wall?
quote: crushing Balaam’s foot against it.

q: In Numbers, what was a bitten Israelite to do to live?
quote: When anyone who is bitten looks at it, he will live.
